title: Critical Registry Query Tenant-Scope Review

checks.control: record snapshot read scoped by tenantId
record update filter includes tenantId + domain + recordId
batch idempotency lookup scoped by tenantId
revision lookup and update scoped by tenantId
tenant identity comes from authenticated claims
transaction session is used for core writes

limitations: These checks inspect source patterns and do not execute the API or database.
A source signal does not prove query semantics, authorization correctness, or absence of indirect data leaks.
Runtime cross-tenant read/write tests and full security review remain required.
The current registry controller has no explicit local role decorator visible; confirm the global guard and role policy before production.
